verdict.rationale: Mastra is a workflow framework whose workflows can suspend and resume, so workflow versioning is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence shows in-flight runs being pinned to the code version they started on, or any determinism-safe versioning mechanism. The 'versioned datasets' claim concerns evaluation data, and suspend/resume plus deployment to Mastra Cloud are adjacent features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I deploy new workflow code while in-flight runs finish on the version they started with — versioning without breaking determinism
